card.name: Inside capitalized Latin and acronym strings
card.fires_on: Pieces in the middle of all-caps strings, such as Roman inscription Latin, drug brand names and acronyms or URLs. It fires on the split-off chunk, not on ordinary lowercase words.

modes.label: Roman inscriptions
modes.description: Chunks inside all-caps Latin words in inscription transcriptions, often legion names.
modes.example: I O M PRO SALV<<TE>> VEXILLATIO NVM LEG XX

modes.label: Capitalized drug names and acronyms
modes.description: Middle pieces of all-caps drug names, disease acronyms or program names in labels.

modes.label: All-caps web address parts
modes.description: Chunks inside a capitalized program name within a URL.

card.plain: It fires in the middle of long all-capital strings, like Latin inscriptions or drug and program abbreviations.
